description: A sync finalizer (Scope::defer_sync, register_sync_finalizer, state.rs:9046): the closure is not run inline by the close, the lab wraps it in a future and spawns it as the region's masked cleanup task (drain_ready_async_finalizers_in, state.rs:8612), so it is a task of the region with its own name, spawn and completion events, run in the one poll of the step after the region finished its tasks.
